proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ a ha hu ⟨⟨d, hd⟩⟩
  have hd' : Ideal.span ({Polynomial.C a, Polynomial.X} : Set (Polynomial A)) = Ideal.span {d} := hd
  have h1 : d ∣ Polynomial.C a := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (hd' ▸ Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
  have h2 : d ∣ Polynomial.X := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (hd' ▸ Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
  have hd0 : d.natDegree = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h1
    have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at he; exact ha he
    have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at he; exact ha he
    have := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree he
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C, Polynomial.natDegree_mul hd0 he0] at this
    omega
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, d = Polynomial.C c := ⟨d.coeff 0, Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hd0⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h2
  have hcu : IsUnit c := by
    have := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 1) he
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_one, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul] at this
    exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one _ this.symm
  have h1m : (1 : Polynomial A) ∈ Ideal.span ({Polynomial.C a, Polynomial.X} : Set (Polynomial A)) := by
    rw [hd']
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (((Polynomial.isUnit_C).mpr hcu).dvd)
  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp h1m
  have := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 0) hfg
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_mul_C, Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_zero, Polynomial.coeff_one_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact hu (IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one _ ((mul_comm _ _).trans this))
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] (a : A), a ≠ 0 → ¬ IsUnit a → ¬ (Ideal.span ({Polynomial.C a, Polynomial.X} : Set (Polynomial A))).IsPrincipal
